items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: We elected Amos the President of the House that Jazz Built

ctx.x: He plays tenor and she plays flute. They played. I, of course, sang and we have a young man, blues singer, Claudio Maxwell who sang -- he's a blues singer, he sang. And after he got through he practically took over and acted as the M.C.

And we transacted a little business. We elected Amos the President of the House that Jazz Built, which he accepted and it was a real ball and at the end of the evening Amos turned over a check for $1,031 to the House that Jazz Built.
